display_name: 源域表示损失与 IQ 梯度方向诊断
description: 在 672 条合法源配对 IQ 上，固定候选和其源辅助编码器，比较 DURA 与候选输出处逐记录表示损失与归一化 IQ 误差的波形梯度方向及大小。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 GPU7, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, FP32 TF32 off, batch 32

data.representation: source paired clean and simulated received IQ; frozen DURA, trained G and training-only auxiliary encoder
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 frozen source pilot physical IDs, RX4/6 and RX8 by seven views; read indices/rx/scene/split only

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: 672 previously explored source pilot IDs disjoint from this candidate fit IDs, not independent of original DURA

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only per-record waveform-output gradient alignment; not parameter gradient, device identity or target performance

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only DURA and fixed final epoch-5 joint-IQ-SSL correction and auxiliary encoder; random encoder reconstructed using its initialization seed
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura source provenance and SSL source summary/checkpoint fields; candidate fit IDs disjoint from 672 source pilot IDs
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed F-free source-only DURA and auxiliary SSL model; target ancestry forbidden
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 5, no metric-based candidate or target selection

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7, one this-run worker, at most three total compute workers; preserve others
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, source smoke failure, nonfinite output or any target/F/TX read; preserve stopped group and other owners.

expected_artifacts: result.json: per RX/scene output-gradient alignment and strength

rows.method: Frozen source SSL feature and normalized IQ losses differentiated with respect to each recovered waveform
rows.purpose: Detect local source waveform objective conflict before planning another candidate
rows.seed_notes: Auxiliary encoder original initialization seed 2026110615; frozen candidate and source pilot; no training or target access.
rows.budget_ref: 672 paired source records, fixed public RX/scene groups, two frozen output positions
expected_artifacts: result.json: per RX/scene output-gradient alignment and strength

notes: No TX labels, F weights/outputs, V or target IQ/truth are read; no model parameters update.
Gradients are computed with respect to each output waveform, not model parameters; IQ objective is normalized IQ error, excluding DURA guard terms.
Previously explored source pilot is disjoint from candidate fitting IDs, not independent of original DURA.
The diagnostic does not modify existing frozen candidates or their ground tests.
